notes:
Summary:
- Enterprise fintech (payments infrastructure). Evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for inference of fraud models + customer chat. Strong security posture, long procurement cycle.

Network & security ask (primary):
- Cerulean network/security insists on PrivateLink endpoints (AWS PrivateLink) over VPC peering for isolation; reasons: stricter egress control, no transitive routing into core network, easier enforcement via ENIs.
- Firewall rules: only allow egress to internal Splunk/SIEM, KMS, and Redwood PrivateLink endpoints. No general outbound internet from inference subnets.
- Egress controls: NAT gateway denied; must use oﬀ-box proxy service (in-house) or VPC endpoints where possible.
- IP allowlists: corporate infra team will supply static egress IP ranges for vendor-managed console access; inference hosts must be restricted to a small CIDR.
- Transit/Scale: planning for Transit Gateway with separate inference VPCs per region (us-east-1 + eu-west-1) and peered control-plane via PrivateLink.

KMS & encryption:
- Require customer-managed keys (BYOK) in AWS KMS; buckets and checkpoints encrypted with Cerulean KMS key.
- HSM integration is a 'nice-to-have' for legal (may convert to must-have after procurement). Need diagram of key flow and where envelope keys are hosted.

Audit & observability:
- Audit logging must forward to Splunk (HTTPS endpoint + SIEM ingestion). Retention: 7 years for sensitive events; need event types list (auth events, model access, config changes).
- Token-level usage traces requested for cost allocation to business units.

Compliance/residency:
- Data residency split: EU PII must remain in eu-west-1; payment transaction vectors must not cross regions. Looking for separate private deployments per region or strict routing.
- SOC2 + ISO27001 expected; legal wants a sec faq and contact for penetration test results.

Performance requirements:
- Throughput target for fraud-reranking: ~2k requests/sec, P95 latency target <150ms for reranking flows. Chat latency less strict but SJ latency must be consistent.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; will trade some latency for lower token cost on non-critical paths.

- 2026-01-15: Intro call (AE + SE) — high-level requirements captured.
- 2026-01-29: Security questionnaire submitted by Cerulean (drive link above).
